saw_lines: Streetwear buyers choose a drop by its story and its look, then compare it with the next drop before they buy.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the drop’s story has to land before the scroll moves on.
Your 27 ads carry no proof number, so pick one real figure, such as orders shipped, and open three new ads with it in line one, before any product shot.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 27 ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Pick one real figure, such as orders shipped, and open three new ads with it in line one.
None of your 27 ads mentions an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a two item bundle in line one of three new ads, printed on the creative itself.

Your ads split between Shop now on 15 ads and See details on 9, so buyers get different next steps for the same product. Choose one call to action per angle and send each one to the page that matches it.

Your ads run across Instagram, Facebook, Threads and Audience Network in one mixed pool, so no placement is judged on its own. Split the Denari creative into separate ad sets per placement, keep the ones that work and cut the rest.
